name: Docker Desktop
key_features: One-click GUI; K8s; Compose; VMM/WSL2/Hyper-V; Hub integration
weaknesses: Heavy on Mac; license paywall >250emp/>$10M; battery/CPU hog
license_or_cost: Free <250emp+<$10M else Pro $9/mo Team $15/u Business; SSA
evidence_quote: Source: https://docs.docker.com/desktop/ Quote: lets you build share run containerized apps

name: OrbStack
key_features: 2s start; VirtioFS; Rosetta x86; K8s; native Swift <0.1% CPU; drop-in
weaknesses: Mac-only; closed-source; paid after trial; small team risk
license_or_cost: Paid per-seat after trial; Terms/Privacy on site
evidence_quote: Source: https://docs.orbstack.dev/ Quote: Starts in 2 seconds optimized network

name: Rancher Desktop
key_features: OSS; K8s + nerdctl/dockerd; Win/Mac/Linux; no license fee
weaknesses: Heavier than OrbStack; K8s complexity; slower file sync
evidence_quote: Source: https://ddev.readthedocs.io/en/stable/ Quote: OrbStack or Lima or Docker Desktop or Rancher Desktop

name: Colima
key_features: Minimal CLI; Docker/Containerd/Incus; Apple Silicon + Rosetta vz; k8s optional
weaknesses: CLI-only no GUI; Lima VM quirks; community support
evidence_quote: Source: https://github.com/abiosoft/colima Quote: container runtimes on macOS with minimal setup

name: Podman Desktop + Podman
key_features: Daemonless rootless; Docker-compat CLI; pods; SELinux; no daemon socket root
weaknesses: Compose compat gaps; socket path differs; Win/Mac needs VM
evidence_quote: Source: https://podman.io/docs Quote: create and maintain containers rootless

name: DevPod (Loft)
key_features: devcontainer.json anywhere; providers local/cloud; 5-10x cheaper than Codespaces; OSS
weaknesses: Requires provider setup; less polished GUI; BYO cloud billing
license_or_cost: Apache-2.0 free client; cloud costs separate
evidence_quote: Source: https://devpod.sh/docs/what-is-devpod Quote: 5-10 times cheaper than existing services

name: GitHub Codespaces
key_features: Zero-install cloud; prebuilds; VS Code web; org billing
weaknesses: Metered $$; cold start; offline impossible; vendor lock-in
evidence_quote: Source: https://docs.github.com/en/codespaces Quote: secure configurable dedicated development environment

name: DDEV
key_features: PHP/Node local envs in minutes; Docker-provider agnostic; WSL2 mirrored guidance
weaknesses: Web-focused not generic orchestrator; needs Docker provider
evidence_quote: Source: https://ddev.readthedocs.io/en/stable/ Quote: launching local web development environments in minutes

name: VS Code Dev Containers
key_features: devcontainer.json standard; features/templates; attach to container
weaknesses: Requires Docker + VS Code; first-build slow; no multi-env dashboard
evidence_quote: Source: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/devcontainers/containers Quote: use a container as full-featured dev environment

name: Testcontainers
key_features: Ephemeral integration-test containers; language SDKs; CI-friendly
weaknesses: Test-only not dev orchestrator; Hub limits affect CI
evidence_quote: Source: https://www.docker.com/pricing/faq/ Quote: 1500 Testcontainers Cloud runtime minutes included

name: Tilt / Skaffold (K8s dev)
key_features: Live-update K8s dev loop; Tiltfile; fast rebuild
weaknesses: K8s-only overkill for Compose-local; learning curve
evidence_quote: Source: https://github.com/docker/compose Quote: running multi-container applications on Docker

name: Lando / Docksal
weaknesses: Aging; Docker Desktop coupled; limited health-verifier model
evidence_quote: Source: https://ddev.readthedocs.io/en/stable/ Quote: take advantage of Docker workflow without experience
